text:
maria.support: urgent escalation from ACME — after we rotated cluster RBAC/credentials this morning, their Dedicated > Pools page shows no nodes for pool 'acme-gpu-1' and GPU counts are 0. Customer is seeing errors in their app. Can eng take a look? https://acme-support/12345 :eyes:

ajay.sre: thanks — can you paste cluster id, exact pool name, and the last 20 lines of the telemetry-agent logs? also tag eng-platform if it's a resync issue

maria.support: cluster: proj-acme-eu-west-2 (cluster-9ab3). pool id: acme-gpu-1. Repro steps I followed:
1) Redwood Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> select acme-gpu-1
2) panel shows "No nodes found" and GPU table empty
3) API call to /inventory/pools/acme-gpu-1 returns an empty nodes array

I grabbed the agent logs (tail):
```
2026-03-17T08:42:10Z INFO starting telemetry-agent v1.4.2
2026-03-17T08:42:11Z WARN RBAC token refresh detected
2026-03-17T08:42:12Z ERROR watch nodes: 403 Forbidden: user "system:serviceaccount:redwood:telemetry" cannot list resource "nodes" in API group "" at the cluster scope
2026-03-17T08:42:12Z ERROR list pods: 403 Forbidden
2026-03-17T08:42:13Z INFO reconnecting in 5s
```

ajay.sre: that 403 is suspicious — looks like the clusterrolebinding lost verbs during the RBAC rotation. can you run this quick check from a bastion with kubeconfig for that cluster?

`kubectl auth can-i list nodes --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood:telemetry --kubeconfig ~/.kube/acme`

if it prints "no" we repro. Also paste output of `kubectl get clusterrolebinding telemetry-binding -o yaml`

maria.support: ran the can-i check, got `no`. telemetry-binding snippet: ```
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: telemetry
  namespace: redwood
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: telemetry-read
```
no verbs listed in the ClusterRole (looks like an empty rules array)

ben.platform: :eyes: ok this matches a migration script that accidentally replaced the ClusterRole with a minimal one during our RBAC sync (we scoped a bunch of roles for least-priv). That would cause the agent to stop reporting nodes and GPU CRs, which explains the empty inventory in the Dedicated dashboard. Is this affecting only acme cluster or others?

maria.support: reported by ACME and also a second tenant (beta-inc). both clusters had RBAC rotation applied at 08:40. some other clusters that were untouched look fine

ajay.sre: plan: 1) restore ClusterRole rules to include list/watch on nodes, pods, customresources for GPU devices and our telemetry CRs 2) trigger inventory resync for affected pools 3) monitor dashboards and confirm nodes reappear. I can craft the restore manifest.

ben.platform: for immediate mitigation you can trigger the internal resync endpoint which forces the control plane to re-pull pool state: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.internal/api/admin/resync?pool=acme-gpu-1` — that will wake up the UI and re-index any recently pushed telemetry once agent regains permissions. Do that after we restore the role.

ajay.sre: applying role restore now (rolling apply across rho clusters) — manifest includes: ```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: telemetry-read
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["nodes","pods"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
- apiGroups: ["inference.redwood.io"]
  resources: ["gpudevices","poolstates"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
```

ajay.sre: role applied, waiting for agent to reconnect. also kicked resync for both pools (acme-gpu-1, beta-gpu-2) via internal API

maria.support: resync curl returned 202 for both. customer confirms dashboard now shows nodes for acme-gpu-1 and GPU counts back. customer still wants root cause & ETA on permanent fix for RBAC rotation scripts.

ben.platform: root cause: our RBAC rotation job had a bug that reconciled ClusterRole objects to an internal minimal spec when migrating namespace-scoped roles. We've patched the rotation job to preserve ClusterRole.rules arrays and added a unit test.

ajay.sre: follow-ups:
- eng-platform to add an alert when Dedicated pool inventory is empty for >5 min and pool has active capacity (owner: ben.platform)
- add can-i check as a preflight in RBAC rotation playbook (owner: eng-sre)
- add automated resync trigger when telemetry-agent reports repeated 403s (owner: eng-runtime)

maria.support: noted and sent summary to customer with timeline and mitigation steps. closing ticket after confirmation. :white_check_mark:

telemetry-bot: Incident follow-up created: IF-2026-113, linked to GH PR #4127 that patches RBAC rotation job

ajay.sre: thanks everyone. marking this thread resolved but leaving follow-ups in tracker. :thumbsup:
